ITEM 1 | Whole round apple, glossy red-and-yellow-green skin with a small stem dimple on top, smooth surface, about 8 cm diameter, sits at upper left of plate on top of some cauliflower florets; roughly 0.12 of plate footprint | 180
ITEM 2 | Halved yellow corn cob piece, bright yellow kernel rows with pale white pith center, cut face flat and dry-looking, about 5 cm across and 3.5 cm tall, sits at upper right of plate near the grapes | 110
ITEM 3 | Cauliflower florets, matte creamy white, bumpy clustered buds with slightly rough texture, firm and holding shape, several pieces roughly 3 to 4 cm each, clustered along lower left of plate beneath the apple; no browning or cooking marks visible | 150
ITEM 4 | Red seedless grapes, glossy dark red to burgundy skin with slight translucency, smooth and round, about 2 cm diameter each, roughly 25 pieces scattered across right side of plate around the corn | 200
ITEM 5 | Green-yellow seedless grapes, glossy pale yellow-green skin with faint pink blush, smooth and round, about 2 cm diameter, 3 pieces at lower right and right edge of plate among the red grapes | 20
